ds.t: As for oneself, so for the deity
w: Today in the mandir, decorations had been offered in each shrine depicting different natural actions and divine episodes of Shriji Maharaj. In the first shrine, the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj had been covered with an upper cloth so that the ears showed, according to His original nature, and a thal (food offering) had been offered. Various dishes had been placed below in front. Mulji Brahmachari stood in attendance with a fan. The sadhus began the thal song "Mare gher aavjo chhogla dhari...". Swamishri kept having darshan of the murti of Thakorji eating. Finally he said to the pujari swami, "Maharaj has sat down to eat, but the thal has been placed right down below (near His feet). If He wants to eat, how much effort would it take?" Saying this, he himself bent down and demonstrated how much trouble it would be to take a mouthful. Then he said, "If the table had been raised, Thakorji could have taken a mouthful easily."

The pujari immediately corrected this mistake. Swamishri constantly feels the very presence of God in the eight kinds of murtis of God. That is why, according to the saying "yatha dehe tatha deve" (as for oneself, so for the deity), he never lets any lapse occur in the ninefold devotion and service of Thakorji.

ds.t: As for the body, so for God
w: Today in each shrine of the mandir, decorations had been offered matching the various natural gestures and divine actions of Shriji Maharaj. In the first shrine, the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj had been covered with an upper cloth in such a way that the ears showed, in keeping with his original nature, and a thal (meal) had been offered. In front, various dishes had been placed below. Mulji Brahmachari was standing in attendance with a fan. The sadhus began the thal "Mare gher aavjo chhogla dhari...". Pramukh Swami Maharaj kept having darshan of the murti of Thakorji eating. At the end he said to the pujari swami, "Maharaj is seated to eat, but the thal has been placed right down below (near his feet). How much trouble it would be for him if he wanted to eat!" Saying this, he himself bent down and demonstrated how much difficulty there would be in taking a mouthful. Then he said, "If the table had been raised, Thakorji could have taken his mouthfuls properly."

The pujari corrected this mistake at once. Day and night Pramukh Swami Maharaj feels the living presence of God in the eight kinds of murtis of God. That is why, in keeping with the saying "As for the body, so for God", he never lets any lapse happen in the ninefold devotion and service of Thakorji.

Swamishri visited the new mandir site and sanctified it and performed the Bhumi pujan ceremony.
At 7.00pm, Swamishri blessed a Medico-Spiritual Conference and thereafter went for darshan to the Sanatan Mandir and attended the evening assembly.
Internet Chatting

During a conversation with Swamishri on internet chatting, someone added that the kishores of Tampa have given up internet chatting after the shibir in Perry, Georgia. Before Swamishri responded, Vijay clarified, "After the shibir in Perry, we have cut down on chatting but not stopped entirely. The reason being that we've been chatting with friends for three years so it takes time ..." Swamishri responded immediately, "Stop it altogether. At this age you should focus on your studies and Satsang. Make an effort to make your life better and beautiful. In chatting, you will waste time and spoil your studies. Your mind will always think about that and its vices will corrupt you. Therefore, study properly and you will achieve happiness and wealth." A youth added, "Bapa, I used to chat before ..." Swamishri interrupted, "Now give it up entirely. Put your efforts in studying as best you can. Because after chatting you will experience an upsetting. Your mind will be upset. And then, preoccupied with those thoughts your academic performance will decline. There is no need for such enticing things." The kishores received Swamishri's loving, direct advice and pledged to give up chatting.
Like this hospital that helps cure physical disease, the way to cure our inner disease lies in reading our scriptures, 'sant samagam' and devotion to God.
We attain the benefits of academic study, but the root of all knowledge is God.
Pujya Shastriji Maharaj Shraddh festival was cancelled and instead prayer-assembly was held in honor of those who had died and were injured in the terrorist attack in Akshardham.

pr.t: The Right to Eat for All
w: After the morning assembly, Swamishri passed by an almond tree while returning to his residence.
There were many almond fruits lying on the ground. A sadhu commented, "Parrots eat a lot of almond fruits."
"Let them eat. Is it that you only require to eat? Don't they need to eat too!" Swamishri replied.
"I don't mind them eating, but they eat only half and throw the rest away," the sadhu added.
"When they eat, they may throw it away. God has so created that every being has a right to eat."
Swamishri's appreciation for God's creatures and the right to their innate habit of eating throws a new light on our ways of living in harmony with nature.
Mahayagna Nagar Yatra Swamishri arrived in Kisumu at 11.00 am following a 30-minite flight from Nairobi.
The Yagna for World Peace was in progress in the mandir when Swamishri arrived at his residence.

In the afternoon a grand procession of the murtis to be consecrated in the new mandir took place. The murtis were housed in beautifully decorated floats and paraded through the streets of Kisumu. In the evening Swamishri attended the welcome assembly in which the Hindu Council of Kenya presented a Special Citation to Swamishri in honour of his work to promote world peace and harmony.
A spiritual seeker asked Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "What should I do so that negative thoughts go away?"
Answering in one sentence, Swamishri said, "Do bhajan."
A small boy had sat on Pramukh Swami Maharaj's table for a meeting. As soon as he saw Swamishri, he said in a loud voice, "My name is Adarsh."
His loud voice drew Swamishri's attention to him, and as if shaking hands with him, Swamishri said, "Say it again."
"Adarsh," he said, in a voice that filled the room.
So Swamishri said, "Then become just that (adarsh, an ideal), study well and do bhajan."
Swamishri likes those who have courage and self confidence.
A boy came for darshan. He said that there were some 521 ghosts in his body. So Pramukh Swami Maharaj immediately said to him, "Who told you that?"
The boy said, "I do not know anything, but sometimes it happens like that and something speaks like this from inside."
Swamishri said, "Do not fall into such superstition. Worship God and pray every day. You have my blessings, everything will be fine."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was reading letters. Meanwhile a spiritual seeker phoned from London. He said, "Please come here to London and travel around, otherwise you will get into the habit of staying in one place."
Swamishri immediately said, "So far I have not got into any habit. It is the grace of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj."
A spiritual seeker phoned. Openly and sincerely he said, "Please do something so that my bad nature and faults go away."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Since you are aware of them, God will be compassionate."

ds.t: Do not fall into such superstition
w: A boy came for darshan. He had as many as 521 ghosts in his body. He told this to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. So Swamishri immediately said to him, "Who told you that?"
The boy said, "I do not know anything, but sometimes it happens and something speaks like this from within."
Swamishri said, "Do not fall into such superstition. Do Bhagwan's bhajan and pray every day. You have my blessings, everything will be fine."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was reading letters. Meanwhile, a seeker phoned from London. He said, "Please come here to London and travel about, otherwise you will get into the habit of staying in one place."
Swamishri immediately said, "So far no habit has formed, by the grace of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj."
A seeker phoned. Openly and without guile, he said, "Please do something so that my bad nature and faults go away."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Since you are aware of them, Bhagwan will have mercy."
Atmaswarupdas Swami pointed to a devotee and asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "Swami! Do you recognise him?"
It was Arunbhai Patel. Swamishri knew him well. Swamishri at once put both his hands on his own neck. Arunbhai immediately understood and burst out laughing. Delighted, he said, "Long hair!"
The sadhus were curious and asked, "When did you keep long hair?"
Arunbhai said, "In 1970, when we lived in Kampala, in Africa."

The amazing thing was that Arunbhai is not very active in satsang now, and yet Swamishri remembers something from 48 years ago exactly! Just as a picture, once captured in a camera, stays preserved unchanged for years, so too does an event once imprinted on Swamishri's mind.
As Mahant Swami Maharaj was going to rest, the sadhus told him about something that had happened in the morning.

While Swamishri was in an important discussion, Jashbhai of Sunav had been brought in during the meeting to receive Swamishri's blessings. His condition was critical. He had a liver problem and had been suffering for a long time. He had Swamishri's darshan. Swamishri blessed him, "Bhagwan will free you from suffering." And as soon as he went out of Swamishri's room, Shriji Maharaj took him to his divine abode.
The sadhus said, "Straight to Akshardham!"
Shriji Maharaj and the Gunatit guru parampara have come to make us supremely happy both in this world and in the next. And they are faithfully living up to this title of theirs.

Mahant Swami Maharaj sang the chesta (the evening hymns describing Bhagwan Swaminarayan's daily routine). After his bath, he came into his bedroom and looked at the clock. It was 10.10. Swamishri at once headed towards the sofa, saying, "Let me read one talk."

What wishes Swamishri has! If he gets two extra minutes, instead of going to sleep he feels like reading Swami ni Vato (the talks of Gunatitanand Swami)! Only after reading one talk as he wished did Swamishri sit on his bed.
